name: Spider 2.0
intro: Spider 2.0 是一个包含632个真实企业级数据库文本转SQL工作流问题的评测框架。数据库来自实际应用，常含1000多列，存储于本地或云端如BigQuery和Snowflake。挑战要求模型处理复杂SQL环境、长上下文、多条SQL语句及复杂推理，远超传统文本转SQL任务。
org: xlang.ai, The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory
eval_feature: 长文本, 多轮, 领域特定, 真实企业级数仓
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multi-turn, Domain-specific, Enterprise Warehouses
intro_en: Spider 2.0 is a benchmark consisting of 632 real-world enterprise-level database text-to-SQL workflow problems. The databases originate from practical applications, often containing over 1,000 columns, stored locally or in the cloud such as BigQuery and Snowflake. The challenge requires models to handle complex SQL environments, long contexts, multiple SQL statements, and intricate reasoning, far exceeding traditional text-to-SQL tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Spider 2.0 arXiv:2411.07763 Sections 2-4 and Appendix; official xlang-ai/Spider2 repository snapshot. Spider 2.0 evaluates LLMs and code agents on realistic enterprise text-to-SQL workflows across BigQuery, Snowflake, SQLite, DuckDB, and dbt. Track A models the collection of 213 enterprise databases and 1,021 SQL / 157 dbt queries, enterprise schema assembly (>1,000 columns), gold query authoring (avg 144 tokens), and multi-round execution QC gate (>=3 rounds cross-validation and red-teaming) into 632 frozen workflow tasks (547 SQL and 85 dbt). Track B details dialect-aware prompt assembly, agentic ReAct reasoning and SQL synthesis, sandboxed live database execution across cloud and local engines, order-agnostic result table equivalence testing with float tolerance, and official Execution Accuracy (EX) and Success Rate (SR) reporting across Lite (547) and Full Agentic (632) suites.
